what: A hidden dot (.625em) before the link text grows from 0 to full size and fills in over .15s on hover (cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)), while the text, which had been pulled left by the dot’s width, is pushed 1.125em to the right over .3s cubic-bezier(.33,0,0,1). The link for the current page always shows the dot on

options.--fx-gap: Gap between dot and text, default .5em — the distance the text shifts is diameter + gap
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Text push length and curve, default .3s · cubic-bezier(.33,0,0,1)
options.look: still: Lights up only the dot without pushing the text (original footer and drawer link style)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text to shift (child). If absent, the link text stays as is and only the dot lights up
options.aria-current: If ”page”, the dot is always on and the text stays where it was pushed to
options.--fx-dot · --fx-dot-ease: Dot color (default text color) · dot grow curve (default cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)) — Brand yellow dot · .5s cubic-bezier(.65,.05,0,1)
options.--fx-dot-fade: Dot initial opacity, default 1 — at 0 it turns on while growing (the original .link-hover-circle goes from opacity 0 to 1)

from.where: index.html Hero nav .e-dot.is-push — original nav link: dot size-2.5 (.625em) scale 0→1·bg transparent→current .3s ease-magic (.33,0,0,1), text -translate-x-4.5 (1.125em)→0

All pages .od-dothover.od-shove (”Book a consultation”, ”See more” — original dot-hover dot-hover-shove: a .5em dot goes scale 0→1 and opacity 0→1 over .5s, text padding moves from 1em on the right → 1em on the left over .5s, both cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1))

shared.css .mj-link — original .link-hover-circle: a .75rem dot grows from width 0 → .75rem, right margin 0 → .5rem, scale 0 → 1 over .5s cubic-bezier(.65,.05,0,1), pushing the text aside (yellow). With this part: --fx-size: .75rem; --fx-gap: .5rem; --fx-dur: .5s; --fx-dot-dur: .5s; --fx-ease·--fx-dot-ease: cubic-bezier(.65,.05,0,1); --fx-dot: accent color

note: The original css writes the dot transition as ”background-color .3s ease-in-out, transform .3s magic”, but it is an invalid value with a length inside transition-property, so the browser discards it and it runs on the Tailwind default (all .15s). We followed the actual behavior as measured (ends in 117ms)
